name: Singularity Core trigger reaches wand distance (#7563)
contract: #7563: Singularity Core 804438 never adds damage to wand attacks or wand spells. Cause: its aura-42 effect triggers 804437, whose DBC RangeIndex 6 is Ten yards, while wand combat lands at 11-30 yd; Spell.cpp CheckCast enforces range even for triggered casts ('Triggered spells also have range check'), so every proc beyond 10 yd fizzles silently. The proc itself is sound: DBC ProcFlags 0x4001C0 cover DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK and DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS at 100% chance, the generated entry's empty family/mask is a wildcard match, and 804437 carries USES_RANGED_SLOT so it scales off the equipped wand. Fix: chronomancer_time_contracts sets 804437's RangeEntry to 30 yards. The dummy stands at 15 yd: inside Wand of Time's range and the fixed trigger range, outside the broken 10 yd. Fails pre-fix (Wand of Time lands, 804437 never deals damage), passes after. Magic-class wand spells (Wand of Entropy, DmgClass MAGIC) never matched these proc flags by design and stay out of scope.
